name: meritocracy-app
description: Full-stack Node.js + React application with Prisma ORM

scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --kill-others "npm run dev-backend" "npm run dev-frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build-backend && npm run build-frontend
scripts.start: npm run setup && npx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --kill-others "npm run start-backend" "npm run start-frontend"
scripts.db:setup: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy --config prisma/prisma.config.js
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && npx prisma db push --force-reset --config prisma/prisma.config.js
scripts.db:dev: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev --config prisma/prisma.config.js
scripts.dev:stop: pkill -f 'npm run dev' || true && pkill -f nodemon || true && pkill -f vite || true && pkill -f 'node src/index.js' || true
scripts.prereqs: docker build -t vporton/fly -f deploy/Dockerfile.fly . && docker image push vporton/fly
